name: labs/diamondlightsource__dodal
title: DECTRIS Eiger area detector (dodal)
intro: DECTRIS Eiger area detector (dodal), adapted from diamondlightsource/dodal. It reads `armed`, `bit_depth`, `stale_params` and `acquisition_id`; runs `stage`, `unstage`, `disarm` and `files`. `stage`: arm the Eiger for one externally triggered collection with the operator's DetectorParams: stage() runs the upstream arming chain unless the detector is armed. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
